entries.prompt: Correct ONLY the red-lens fittings of the SECOND isolated Celtic PHG HuntingParty3 mask,using the FIRST official group render as source authority: the relevant character is the LEFT figure. SECOND incorrectly has two red lenses at EACH temple. The actual source image-LEFT temple has exactly THREE small red physical lenses in a compact TRIANGLE; restore that source triplet in the same housing. The actual source image-RIGHT temple has a dark elongated oval recess/relief under reddish illumination,NOT two circular red lenses: remove only the two invented red lens discs on image-right,and preserve the actual dark elongated oval rigid relief as in FIRST. Do NOT mirror/symmetrize modules or add new hardware,slots,lenses or glowing discs. Keep every other part of SECOND exactly: same oblique camera/tilt,projected proportions,whole smooth crown contour,black eye inserts,vertical ribbed muzzle,lateral curved cheek ridges,metal wear and source blue/red lighting. These are colored LIGHTS,not intrinsic paint. No rotation,new front,hidden geometry or redesign. Exclude all wearer biology,eyes,skin,mandibles,dreads,hair rings,neck,body/armor,shoulder weapon,other figures and scene. Exactly one complete isolated rigid mask,genuine transparent RGBA,10percent clear transparent margin around entire crown/chin,longest axis78-80percent canvas,no background,floor,shadow plane,glow halo,text or UI. This is a precise source-visible lens count/ownership correction only.
